Name: Kandis Dark Rain
Author: KandiKraze
Description:
HI! ever had a dark playthrough and wanted to make it a bit drearier, a bit darker, or even a bit edgier? Look no further than Kandis Dark Rain! It might not look like much, but it recolors the rain to be darker and gloomier! (I made this for a personal playthrough but thought I would post it)
